testCase.name: [local] S21 axe, phone width and WebKit on the Medications panel and the Medication Tracker, every status, both contexts

descriptionHtml:
Suggestion A1 · accessibility · not counted as a bug (was P2): accessibility is not asked for by any UAT item or ticket, so this is a suggestion, not a bug (Quinn 2026-10-14)

Buttons, inputs and dropdowns have no accessible name (Nursing Home +, settings, back, close X, task done/delete, medication status dropdown); also some focus jumps to the top and small tap targets

Tickets: — · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: local (visual check)

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): OAT-01/S21, OAT-06/S24b, TC-03/S21, TC-11/S20, TC-12/S20, TC-14/S22, TC-21/S20, TC-22/S20

Approach · TC-19 Medication Tracker · S21 axe, phone width and WebKit on the Medications panel and the Medication Tracker, every status, both contexts

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 The pre-round medication list and the encounter Medication Tracker are one set of rows: a row the pre-round Save Note writes shows in the Post-Round tracker and a change from Save & Extract shows on … (UAT TC-19; TFA-92597 What; TFA-92597 AC 3)
  • U12 Nursing Home has its own Medications panel, filled from the pre-round (PR #56). (UAT TC-19 ER 9; TFA-92597 AC 3)

Test design technique: Accessibility (accessibility) — Check screen-reader, keyboard, contrast and tap-size rules (axe): users with disabilities have to be able to use it too.

Given Visual-lane fixture with rows in every status (active, held, changed, discontinued, single dose, one row last mentioned 20 h ago for the label), including long names, tags and reasons; profiles desktop, pixel7 (Chromium) and iphone15 (WebKit)

When Run axe and the layout checks on Hospital Pre-Round (panel read-only and editor open), Hospital Post-Round → meds, and Nursing Home Pre-Round (panel read-only and editor open)

Then No WCAG 2 A/AA violations; every status has a text badge, not colour alone; 'Remove <drug>' buttons, the status select and the change-note input have accessible names. On phone width and WebKit: drug name, change tag and reason wrap without truncation or sideways scroll; status badge readable; Edit, Remove and Save Medications tappable (≥ 24 px)

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): axe-core: zero serious or critical violations (visual-checks.ts); visual-lane checks covered / overflow / truncated / tap on the same elements on the phone profiles (merged from the former S22; S23 is the device scenario on real phones)

Where it ran: local visual lane (screenshots + axe); test method VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); lane planned in the matrix: visual / mobile (automated)

S21 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-19.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Suggestion · our own check · environment local · tickets TFA-92597 ready for qa

A screen-reader user editing medications hears 'popup button, held' with no drug name, because each row's status dropdown has no accessible name.

Evidence: Allure b6579774, visual lane: 62 checks passed, 21 failed. axe select-name (critical) on every status select. The change-note inputs are named only by their placeholder (recorded). The phone layout and tap sizes pass. Not in the dev report or ledger.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane visual.

Test method: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: visual.

UAT item: TC-19 Medication Tracker · Section: A4 · Post-Round · Scenario: TC-19/S21

axe, phone width and WebKit on the Medications panel and the Medication Tracker, every status, both contexts

Tickets: TFA-92597 Medication Tracker (ready for qa)

New local lane visual: status failed in visual/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

How it is tested (visual/plan.json, automatable: yes): preround.spec.ts: six seeded medications (active, held, changed, discontinued, single-dose, one 20 h old) in both contexts: panel read-only and editor open, plus Hospital Post-Round → meds; axe, text badge per status, Remove/status select/change-note names, phone layout and sizes. [2026-10-14 review] 'covered' added to the phone layout checks (the oracle names covered / overflow / truncated / tap).

Detail:

desktop, iphone15, pixel7: 62 judged check(s) passed, 21 failed. Every status has a text badge; Remove <drug> buttons are named; change-note inputs are named only by placeholder (recorded); phone layout and sizes pass.

Product issue: In the Medications editor every row's status dropdown (active / held / changed / discontinued / single-dose) has no accessible name (axe select-name, critical): VoiceOver reads 'popup button, held' with no drug — a physician using a screen reader cannot tell which drug's status they are changing (oracle: the status select has an accessible name).

Recorded-only cells (recorded): vision-review (for a person): one row says 'discontinued' in its badge and 'Stopped · Oct 13' in its change chip; Pre-Round panel and Post-Round tracker style the same statuses differently.

Evidence: 8 attached; 1 not attached:

  • visual/evidence/TC-19_S21 — a folder (33 items), not attached

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane V: visual-lane.ts reads a make-session.ts fixture (a fresh local account made with the admin key), and make-session.ts refuses dev, so it runs on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
